description:
Open the dataset 'TitanicSurvival.csv' in Jamovi. Create a new Computed Variable named 'Cohort' to classify passengers into three mutually exclusive groups based on specific criteria:

1. 'Elite': Female passengers in 1st class who are 18 years or older.
2. 'Labor': Male passengers in 3rd class who are 18 years or older.
3. 'Other': All other passengers (including children, other classes, or missing age).

(Hint: Use the IF function with 'and' operators. Note that text values are case-sensitive: 'female', 'male', '1st', '3rd').

After creating the variable, apply a Filter to exclude the 'Other' group (keep only 'Elite' and 'Labor').

Run a Contingency Table (Chi-square test) with 'Cohort' as Rows and 'survived' as Columns. Enable 'Observed' counts and 'Row' percentages.

Save the project as '~/Documents/Jamovi/Titanic_Cohorts.omv'.

Finally, create a text report at '~/Documents/Jamovi/cohort_report.txt' with the exact observed survivor counts and survival rates for the two groups in this format:
Elite Survived: [count]
Labor Survived: [count]
Elite Survival Rate: [percentage]%
Labor Survival Rate: [percentage]%
